body.name: hatSigma
body.def: For aligned vectors \(Y_s=(X_s^{(a)})_{a\in S}\), \(\widehat\Sigma_{\mathrm{pair}}^{SS}=n_S^{-1}\sum_{s=1}^{n_S}Y_sY_s^{\mathsf T}\); for all available viewwise observations, \(\widehat\Sigma_{\mathrm{marg}}^{aa}=n_a^{-1}\sum_{s=1}^{n_a}X_s^{(a)}(X_s^{(a)})^{\mathsf T}\).
